name: Adonikam
overview: Adonikam, also known as Adonijah, is identified in Scripture as a Jewish leader whose family returned from Babylonian exile with Ezra. The records in Ezra 2:13 and Nehemiah 7:18 note the significant number of his descendants, highlighting a large and faithful remnant returning to Jerusalem. His mention alongside other leaders in Nehemiah 10:16 underscores his role in the covenant community reestablishing God's people in their land.
